title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Our client is seeking a Customer Service Advisor to join their team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Maximise customer awareness of all available company services.
- Ensure the highest level of customer care and satisfaction at all times.
- Maintain excellent standards of departmental administration.
- Organise daily collection and delivery operations.
- Monitor sales against objectives.
- Track Customer Satisfaction Indicators.
- Maintain Bodyshop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Customer Service Advisor

Customer Awareness and Service Promotion:
- Promote all Bodyshop and Retailer services to maximise customer awareness.
- Ensure customers are informed about all products and services available.
- Proactively approach customers and assist with inquiries relating to vehicle repairs, parts, and vehicle sales.

Customer Care and Satisfaction:
- Maintain a visible presence at the reception desk, promptly addressing customer queries in person or by telephone.
- Respond to customer questions regarding technical issues clearly and without excessive jargon, or refer to the appropriate team member as necessary.
- Handle dissatisfied customers calmly and escalate complaints to the Bodyshop Manager.
- Initiate new claims on the management system, maintain accurate customer records, and follow up as required.
- Manage initial customer contact and bookings in accordance with company and insurance policies.
- Follow established procedures when issuing courtesy cars, ensuring all paperwork is correctly completed and copies of driving licences are obtained when applicable.
- Maintain up-to-date, computerised customer records, documenting all communications and events thoroughly.
- Manage communications systems with customers and insurers as required.
- Assist the Bodyshop Manager with administrative tasks as needed.
- Ensure compliance with all health and safety, environmental, and company policies.
- Receive and register payments for work completed, adhering to company procedures for verification, handling, and depositing of cash.
- Prepare and present invoices promptly upon job completion, ensuring all work is accurately detailed and charged, and obtain payment in line with company protocols.
- Ensure all job pack paperwork, including wheel alignment and final inspection documents, is scanned and filed correctly.

Collection and Delivery Operations:
- Coordinate daily collection and delivery operations effectively.
- Maintain close liaison with parts and workshop teams, attending daily production meetings.
- Notify customers promptly upon completion of work and arrange convenient vehicle returns.
- Ensure adequate resources are available to meet collection and delivery requirements.
- Monitor and manage loan car requirements in coordination with workshop control.

Salary and Benefits:
- Salary: £30,000, rising to £32,000 following successful probationary period.
- Excellent benefits package.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

Our client, an international market leader, is looking for an experienced Sales Administrator to join their growing team.

The role is available due to internal promotion and is offered with career progression potential.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end order process from inputting orders through to delivery of products. Key tasks include:
- Processing high value orders on SAP ensuring accuracy and to agreed timescales.
- Liaising with European manufacturing plants in countries such as France, Italy and Germany.
- Communicating with shipping companies and providing documentation for smooth customs clearance.
- Keeping the customer advised of progress and relaying and resolving any issues.
- Working closely with internal colleagues in stock, warehousing, sales and finance.
- Processing invoices and sending to customers.
- Maintaining the rental contract database, SAP database and Excel spreadsheets.

Ideally you will have previous experience in sales administration, customer service or shipping within a manufacturing business. You must have excellent communication, organisation and attention to detail. You need to be IT literate and a knowledge of SAP would be advantageous but not essential.

For further details please contact one 2one Recruitment.

title: Sales Account Administrator (6mth FTC)

- Set up and maintain customer accounts.

About You
- Previous experience in a Sales Administration, Customer Service, Account Administration, or Office Support role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
- Confidence in communicating with internal stakeholders, customers, and sales teams.
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach with a strong team ethic.
- The ability to work successfully under pressure and meet deadlines.

Skills & Experience
- Minimum of 3 years' experience in sales administration, customer service, or a similar administrative support role.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
- Experience using Salesforce CRM or similar customer relationship management systems.
- Experience working with ERP systems such as IFS, Agile, SAP, Oracle, or similar would be beneficial.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A-Level, NVQ, or equivalent qualification preferred.

title: Business Coordinator/ Junior PA
description:
Business Coordinator & Junior PA

Location: Gerrards Cross, Buckinghamshire
Salary: £30,000 £35,000, depending on experience
Working pattern: Hybrid minimum three days per week in person
Travel: Occasional travel to Central London
Requirement: Full UK driving licence and access to a car

Are you confident, highly organised and naturally driven? Are you the kind of person who spots what needs doing and makes it happen?

We are recruiting a Business Coordinator & Junior PA to work closely with a dynamic entrepreneur and Managing Director of a growing consultancy. This is a varied and influential role combining business coordination, operational support, reporting, systems administration and personal assistance.

You will act as the Managing Director s eyes and ears across the business, helping to connect sales, marketing, project delivery and operations. You will need to be confident working with different personalities, comfortable holding people accountable and able to turn conversations into clear actions and results.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious coordinator or junior PA who wants greater responsibility and exposure to how a growing business operates.

The role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as a central point of coordination between the Managing Director and teams across sales, marketing, operations and project delivery
- Monitoring priorities, actions and deadlines, following up with colleagues to ensure commitments are completed
- Identifying and escalating potential risks, delays and operational issues
- Supporting internal meetings, planning cycles and business reviews

- Producing reports covering sales pipelines, project progress, utilisation and other key business measures
- Helping to establish clear processes, responsibilities and reporting routines

About you

We are looking for someone who is:
- Driven, confident and proactive, with a strong personality and a positive approach
- A natural organiser who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion
- Comfortable working directly with an entrepreneurial Managing Director in a busy, fast-changing environment
- Confident dealing with people at all levels and able to be firm while remaining professional and respectful
- Numerically capable and comfortable working with budgets, trackers and business data
- Technically confident and able to learn CRM, project-management and reporting systems quickly
- Process-driven, with the confidence to introduce improvements and encourage others to follow agreed ways of working
- Analytical, commercially aware and able to identify potential problems
- A clear and professional written and verbal communicator
- Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential business and personal information
- Flexible and willing to support across a broad range of business activities

Experience required
- At least one year s experience in a PA, team coordination, business support, project coordination or similar role
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills
- Experience coordinating people, projects, deadlines or processes
- Confidence using CRM systems or other business technology
- Experience managing budgets, trackers or numerical information
- A full UK driving licence and access to a car
- The ability to work from Gerrards Cross for a minimum of three days per week and travel to Central London when required

Previous experience in a small, growing or entrepreneurial business would be particularly valuable.

Package and benefits
- Salary of £30,000 £35,000, depending on experience
- Annual profit-share scheme
- 25 days annual leave, increasing with service

This role would suit someone who wants more than a traditional administration position. You will be close to the centre of the business, trusted with meaningful responsibility and given the opportunity to make a visible impact as the company grows.

title: Paraplanner
description:
Paraplanner Buckinghamshire Up to £65,000 + Benefits and annual bonus

We are working with a highly regarded, chartered financial planning firm seeking an experienced Technical Paraplanner to join their team. The practice specialises in working with High-Net-Worth clients, offering a sophisticated and comprehensive financial planning service.

The Role
- This is a technically demanding position in which you will work closely with 1 or 2 Advisers to deliver high-quality, fully researched client solutions across a broad range of complex cases.
- You will conduct extensive research and produce technical assessments, suitability letters and full financial plans, including cashflow modelling, contingency planning, legacy and succession planning, and tax planning.
- You will attend client meetings where appropriate, conduct in-depth meeting preparation, and produce follow-up reports and analysis, ensuring complex information is translated into clear and accessible client correspondence.
- You will manage ongoing portfolio reviews, liaise with providers, maintain accurate client records, and obtain product quotes, illustrations and supporting literature, whilst ensuring all work meets compliance and high ethical standards.

About You
- Level 4 CII Diploma in Financial Planning (or equivalent) is essential for this role.
- You will be a technically strong Paraplanner with experience working on complex cases for sophisticated, well-informed clients who may challenge advice.
- You will take an analytical and methodical approach to client recommendations, with excellent attention to detail, strong data skills and the ability to prioritise effectively to meet deadlines.
- Above all, you will bring professionalism, initiative and a genuine commitment to delivering outstanding outcomes for clients and contributing positively to the wider team.

For further details about this and many other opportunities within Financial Services, please contact Andrew Stark at Synchronicity Wealth.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
The Role:

We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join our busy team here at Agria Pet Insurance.

In this role, you'll be the first point of contact for our valued customers, ensuring their inquiries, concerns, and needs are handled with professionalism and care.

Working to agreed service levels, you'll be responsible for both inbound and outbound calls.

You'll be an enthusiastic individual who is passionate about providing outstanding customer service and promoting our brand.

We have a hybrid approach to work and all attend the Aylesbury office every Wednesday.

The start date for this role is 21st September and you will be required to attend a two week in office induction when you start.

You must be able to commit to these arrangements and start date in order to be considered for this role.

This is a full time role working 36 hours per week between the hours of 9:00am-6:00pm Monday-Friday on a rotating shift pattern. You will also be required to work 1 Saturday in 4, 9:00am-1:00pm.

What you'll be doing:
- Answer all Customer and Claims incoming calls efficiently and professionally
- Outbound calling including; retention and renewal, breeders, requesting information for claims and underwriting of new policy applications
- Objection handling including; policy cancellations, premium increases, Claims decisions
- Respond to customer enquiries appropriately, ensuring all documentation is professional and correct
- Deal and attempt to resolve customer complaints
- Record and maintain accurate policyholder information using the in-house computer systems
- Maintain a thorough working knowledge of all policy terms and conditions
- Ensure all company and departmental policies and procedures are adhered too at all times

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience of working in a customer service role within a contact centre environment
- Effective questioning and listening skills.
- Good organisational and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.
- Computer literate (MS Office) with keyboard skills.
- Precise comprehension and ability to communicate clearly in both verbal and written form.
- Ability to work to agreed performance targets.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Takes ownership by using Initiative and problem solving
- Ability to cope well under pressure with determination and perseverance

Why choose Agria Pet:

Agria Pet Insurance is one of the UK's leading specialist pet insurance providers. We only provide lifetime insurance for animals, so truly understand and care about our customers and their beloved pets - especially as most of our team are pet parents, and we're all animal-lovers. Our passion for pets means that we are trusted by The Royal Kennel Club, Lloyds and many other significant affinity partners to provide lifetime pet insurance in their names.

Working closely with animal welfare organisations, vets and breeders, gives us deep insight on what's best for pets. And we give back too - including supporting hundreds of animal rescues, protecting over 100,000 rescued animals, and through donations of over £2m to animal charities.

We are a strong, growing business, having doubled our GWP in the last 5 years, with a supportive ethos and family feel. We became one of the UK's Best Workplaces in and again in 2026, we have the top 4 slots on Which? Best Buy pet insurance, are ranked 4.8 on Trustpilot (higher than any other pet insurance provider) and we are extremely proud to be the only carbon negative pet insurer in the UK.

What we offer:
- 25 days annual leave which increases with service, plus bank holidays
- Opportunity to buy/sell up to 5 days annual leave per calendar year
- A clear development pathway within the team, helping you grow your skills and progress through levels - with pay increases as you advance.
- Pension and Life Assurance scheme
- Access to 25% off insuring your pet with Agria. Friends and family are also entitled to a discount too
- We aim to support the health and wellbeing of all our colleagues so you'll have access to a Health Cash Plan, mental health support and health and wellbeing platforms, including Headspace

title: Administrator
description:
Multi-Skilled Administrator

£30,000 DOE Career Progression Full Training Provided

Applicants will need to have your own transport to get to this role due to location of the client site.

Monday to Sunday

9am to 5pm

Shift Pattern

Basic 37.5 hour week

Are you highly organised, detail-driven and ready to build a long-term career in international logistics and customs compliance?

This is your opportunity to join a fast-growing logistics and customs operation where accuracy, teamwork and progression truly matter.

We re seeking a Multi-Skilled Clearance Administrator to join our client s dynamic Customs Clearance & Data Bureau team. This is a varied, hands-on role combining customs documentation, data processing, client communication and operational support perfect for someone who enjoys responsibility and variety in their day.

The Opportunity

As a Multi-Skilled Clearance Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in preparing and processing import/export customs clearances, supporting internal departments and delivering excellent customer service.

Approximately 15% of the role involves physical checks of vehicle contents, adding variety and practical involvement to your day.

If you re process-focused, thrive on precision and want to grow within international logistics, this role offers genuine career progression with full training and support.

Key Responsibilities of the Administrator
- Monitoring and managing shared workflow mailboxes
- Processing and routing emails to internal departments
- Communicating with clients via phone and email regarding job status
- Receiving data files and job instructions via email and SFTP
- Preparing, checking and processing import/export customs documentation
- Calculating and verifying duties, taxes and international charges
- Ensuring full compliance with HMRC and Border Force regulations
- Using Sequoia, Savvy (bespoke system) and other customs entry systems
- Conducting visual inspections of vehicle contents when required
- Maintaining organised workspaces and contributing to process improvements

What theye re Looking For

Essential:
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Confident IT user (Excel & Word)
- Professional written and verbal communication skills
- Flexible, reliable and trustworthy
- Able to follow procedures and work independently

Desirable:
- GCSE Maths & English (Grade C/4+) or equivalent
- A/AS Level or graduate calibre
- Knowledge or interest in IT, data or databases
- Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables)
- Experience with customs software or logistics systems

What s in It for You?
- Up to £30,000 DOE
- Full training and ongoing development
- Clear career progression in customs and logistics
- Supportive, team-focused environment
- Monthly performance development reviews
- Annual performance review

Important Information
- Ability to independently travel to and from site required
- Security screening and compliance checks mandatory
- Right to Work in the UK and Photo ID required

Ready to launch your career in customs clearance and logistics?

Apply today and become part of a business that values precision, teamwork and professional growth.

Your future in international logistics starts here.

title: Procurement Assistant
description:
Procurement Assistant - Office Based 5 Days Per Week
About the Opportunity
Are you highly organised, detail-oriented and passionate about delivering exceptional customer service? We're recruiting on behalf of a growing business seeking a Procurement Assistant to support the successful delivery of exciting projects.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous procurement, purchasing, account management or project coordination experience who enjoys building strong relationships, managing multiple priorities and ensuring projects run smoothly from order through to delivery.

- A proactive, positive and solutions-focused approach.

- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.

What's in it for You?
- Join a friendly, supportive and collaborative team.

- Excellent exposure to procurement, supplier management and project coordination.
- Career development opportunities within a growing business.
- Beautiful office environment with a team-first culture.

If you're looking for a varied role where you can develop your procurement and account management skills while working on exciting projects, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Service Delivery Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Service Delivery Coordinator
Location: Milton Keynes
Work Model: Hybrid

Are you a highly organised professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy bringing people, schedules and priorities together to achieve outstanding results?

If so, we are looking for a motivated Service Delivery Coordinator to join our Client Services and Operational Delivery teams on a full-time and permanent basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys problem-solving, relationship building, and ensuring that business commitments are delivered efficiently and effectively.

About the role:

In this role, you will play a key part in coordinating internal resources, managing schedules, supporting operational delivery, and providing an exceptional experience for both internal and external stakeholders. Working closely with colleagues across multiple teams, you will help maximise diary availability and achieve performance targets whilst contributing to operational success.

What you'll be doing:
- Proactive diary management which involves managing schedules, bookings, and resource allocation for our Audit and Training delivery teams.
- Coordinating activities across internal teams and external stakeholders to meet operational targets and service commitments.
- Monitoring workloads, utilisation levels, and key performance indicators to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Communicating confidently with clients and colleagues via telephone, email, and virtual meetings.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders to resolve issues, manage expectations, and support business objectives.
- Handle administrative and system-based processes accurately and within agreed service levels.
- Support planning activities, reporting requirements, and operational projects as required.
- Manage changing priorities whilst finding practical solutions to scheduling and delivery challenges.

Required experience:
- Experience in a planning, coordination, administration, customer service, and/or an operations support role.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Experience working to targets, KPIs, or service level agreements.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to finding solutions.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team.
- Knowledge of systems such as SAP, Salesforce, or similar would be desirable.

Language Requirements: English with European languages desirable e.g. German, Dutch, Spanish, Italian and French.

What will make you successful?

In this role, you'll be someone who:
- Puts customers and stakeholders at the heart of everything you do.
- Enjoys collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.
- Remains calm and resilient when priorities change.
- Takes ownership and accountability for delivering results.
- Is adaptable, agile, and constantly looking for ways to improve processes.

Why join us?

You'll join a collaborative and supportive team where your contribution has a real impact on business performance and customer satisfaction. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and provide opportunities to develop your career within a dynamic and growing organisation.

Our benefits
BSI offers an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 27-days annual leave excludin Bank Holidays, paid sick leave, health insurance, life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, income protection, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid parental leave, adoption leave, compassionate leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Salary Range
The base salary for this position can range from £26,775 - £28,000 per annum; actual compensation is based on various factors, including but not limited to; candidate competencies, level of experience, education, location, divisional budget and internal peer compensation comparisons.

Job Description Job title: Receptionist/Administrator Location: Purbeck Health Centre, Milton Keynes Hours: Working pattern to be agreed Reports to: Reception Lead/Practice Manager The Receptionist/Administrator will be one of the first points of contact for patients and visitors. The postholder will provide a professional and welcoming reception service, manage telephone calls and patient enquiries, and complete a range of computer-based administrative duties. The role is essential to supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and ensuring patients receive a helpful, efficient and respectful service. Welcome patients and visitors in a friendly, caring and professional manner. Check patients in for appointments and assist with general enquiries. Support the smooth flow of patients through the practice. Communicate with clinicians and other team members when required. Keep the reception area calm, tidy and organised. Respect patients privacy and maintain confidentiality at all times. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and courteously. Book, amend and cancel appointments accurately using SystmOne. Respond to general enquiries and direct patients to the appropriate service or member of staff. Follow practice procedures when receiving urgent or emergency calls and escalate concerns immediately where required. Take clear and accurate messages and pass them to the appropriate clinician or administrator promptly. Communicate sensitively with patients who may be worried, distressed or frustrated. Update patient contact details, appointment information and records accurately. Process online appointment requests, messages and administrative queries. Maintain accurate patient records, tasks and worklists on SystmOne. Monitor emails, call queues and other practice communication systems. Support the smooth running of the days appointments and reception services. Complete general administrative duties, including printing letters, preparing lists and entering data. Follow practice procedures for filing, communication and information sharing. Work closely with reception colleagues to maintain appropriate cover for the front desk and telephone lines. Communicate clearly and professionally with clinicians, administrators and management. Provide additional cover during colleagues annual leave or sickness where required. Attend team meetings, training sessions and practice updates. Contribute ideas that could improve patient services or working processes. Promote a positive, respectful and supportive working environment. Follow all practice policies and procedures, including those relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, information governance and data protection. Maintain a professional, respectful and positive approach. Report incidents, risks or concerns promptly to the Reception Lead or Practice Manager. Complete all required mandatory training. Keep knowledge of practice systems, policies and procedures up to date. Work within the responsibilities and boundaries of the role. Excellent communication and telephone skills. A friendly, polite and approachable manner. Confidence using computers and learning new systems. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Ability to remain calm and professional in a busy environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. A reliable, flexible and supportive approach to teamwork. Understanding of the importance of patient confidentiality. Commitment to providing a high standard of patient service. Previous experience in a GP practice, healthcare setting or customer-facing role. Experience using SystmOne or another clinical record system. The postholder must promote equality, diversity and inclusion and treat all patients, visitors and colleagues with dignity, fairness and respect. The postholder must take reasonable care of their own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by their work. Any hazards, incidents or concerns must be reported promptly in accordance with practice procedures. All patient, staff and practice information must be treated as confidential. The postholder must follow UK GDPR, data protection requirements, NHS information governance standards and practice policies. The postholder will be expected to: Uphold the values and reputation of Purbeck Health Centre. Follow all practice policies, procedures and applicable NHS requirements. Take responsibility for their own learning, training and professional development. Contribute to a positive, supportive and inclusive workplace. Carry out other reasonable duties appropriate to the role. This job description provides an overview of the role and is not exhaustive. Duties may change as the needs of the practice develop, following appropriate discussion with the postholder and their line manager.
